scopeReview: IMP-1.B: collection of geographic information through field observations, interviews, census/government data, GPS, GIS, remote sensing and volunteered information. Sampling/metadata cautions serve geographic data interpretation, not advanced statistics or legal advice.
varietyReview: Eleven distinct methods/quality/provenance scenarios, four interpreted stimuli, varied answer positions and all five skills. Foundational recognition is paired with applied sampling, missing data and disclosure analysis.
repetitionReview: No duplicate prompt or number-only clone of Topic 1.1. Different stimuli and acquisition questions; reference to maps does not make decorative art count as evidence.

questions.correctOption: Use the resident’s words as qualitative evidence and the counted passengers as quantitative evidence.
questions.independentReview: Independently classified each observation by what its values mean, not merely whether numerals appear. A quoted experience is qualitative; a tally counts people; an identifier is nominal.

questions.correctOption: Residents aged 65+ are represented at a lower participation rate than the two younger groups.
questions.independentReview: Independently divided user counts by eligible residents: 600/1000=.6,1200/2000=.6,100/1000=.1. The comparison concerns representation, not proof of any group’s travel behavior.

questions.correctOption: Comparisons may have more missing image evidence in the south; low usable coverage is not itself a land-cover measurement.
questions.independentReview: Compared mean cloud-free coverage north=(80+95)/2=87.5%, south=(10+15)/2=12.5%. The missing-data caution follows; neither vegetation nor classification correctness is encoded.

questions.correctOption: Repeat observations on both streets during matched days and time windows, using the same counting rules.
questions.independentReview: Checked metadata separately from count magnitudes. The table supports 360 versus160 observed vehicles/hour, but it does not separate street effects from weekday/time-of-day sampling.

questions.correctOption: A receiver using Global Positioning System satellite signals.
questions.independentReview: Separated geographic positioning from thematic summaries, non-georeferenced imagery and measured site attributes. No exact GPS accuracy or paid service claim is made.

questions.correctOption: It stores and relates georeferenced layers, allowing spatial queries after coordinate compatibility is checked.
questions.independentReview: Independently distinguished GIS integration/query capability from GPS positioning and remote data acquisition. Coordinate compatibility is a precondition, not an automatic truth.

questions.correctOption: Whether reporting access and participation differ by district, using additional systematic field observations.
questions.independentReview: Considered two compatible mechanisms—more potholes and more reporting—so counts alone do not identify the full distribution. Field coverage can assess missingness without stereotyping residents.

questions.correctOption: Detailed accounts of meanings and experiences that can be coded for recurring themes.
questions.independentReview: Matched the instrument to its actual output: qualitative participant accounts. Coding themes does not make the interview sample automatically representative of all residents.

questions.correctOption: The student is analyzing secondary data originally collected by another organization.
questions.independentReview: Checked provenance rather than novelty of presentation. Data remain secondary to the student even when a new map or derived measure is created.
Identified the actual acquisition instrument and repeated-date design. Held season/resolution comparable without claiming perfect classification or a causal conclusion.

questions.correctOption: Aggregate tracks to appropriate corridor zones and suppress sensitive endpoints, after checking that small groups remain difficult to identify.
questions.independentReview: Evaluated what remains inferable from the released geometry. The correct option reduces detail and checks residual risk; all alternatives retain exact sensitive endpoints or promise unsupported anonymity.
